seasonal.summary: Tonto order 03-12-03-24-65: seasonal bald-eagle closure areas on the Lower Salt. Alert Start Date: December 1, 2024 Alert End Date: June 30, 2026. The order has expired and no renewal for Dec 1, 2026 was found; check before winter trips.
Tonto order 03-12-01-24-64 (Box Bar eagle closure): will remain in effect seasonally each year from December 1 through June 30 , until June 30, 2026. No renewal found; Box Bar stays pending.
AZ State Parks Paddle Map 2: eagle no-stopping zones Dec 1 - Jun 30 at guide Mile 2.3-4.3 (Scenic) and Mile 36.9-38.1 (Wild). is closed to stopping from December 1 to June 30

advisories.summary: USGS 09502000 (Salt River below Stewart Mountain Dam) read 6.12 cfs at the check (2026-10-25, ~2 PM MST). A near-zero reading suggests no dam release at check time (inference, not an agency statement). Do not publish a live ETA from this reading; the gauge is flagged in gauge-checks-AZ.json.
Lottery date conflict between Tonto pages and Recreation.gov (see permits.json). The take-out has no agency coordinate captured.

BLM: two smooth-wire fences cross the river 1.3 and 2.7 river miles below the Old Safford Bridge put-in. float boaters should exercise caution upon approaching them, especially at water levels above 100 cubic feet per second
Verde Falls Rapid (Class IV) at guide Mile 2.6 below Beasley Flat; portage or scout (AZ State Parks Paddle Map 2).
Motorized equipment or boats are prohibited within the Salt River Canyon Wilderness.
